thread:
morgan: Intake update from assessor: they require a signed evidence bundle, RBAC baseline+diff, KMS usage log, and a guaranteed retest window within 72h for P1/P2. Can we lock process?
priya: I can run baseline snapshot and produce diffs. Prefer to exclude CI/service accounts per policy. Will upload to gs://evidence-exports/assessments/178999/baseline.json + sha256.
ingrid: Audit asks for raw event ordering; do not reorder events during redaction. We'll redact emails by hashing but keep request_id and resource path.
james: For keys: ephemeral KMS role scoped to decrypt/test-key only. TTL 6h. I'll enable key-usage logging to key-usage-audit stream and include it in bundle.
ops-oncall: Ops requirement: presigned links max 30d. We'll mirror objects to evidence-archive with 90d retention after the window and record checksums. Also will rotate readroom creds immediately post-window.
morgan: Triage SLA suggestion: ack within 8h, initial triage 24h, patch ETA 5d for P2. Retest hold: ops to reserve a contingent morning slot within 72h.
priya: Dry-run proposed Wed 2026-06-10 14:00 UTC to validate presigned objects and the archive mirror. I'll produce a README.md in the bundle listing commands used and redaction rules.
ingrid: Add KV-layer traces: two short 90s samples (startup + steady-state) focused on kv_evictions; include manifest with md5s. Keep total < 15MB.
james: I'll add runtime tracer flags and wire sample capture into the dry-run.
morgan: Security-bot please open a tracking ticket and seed checklist (baseline snapshot, presigned bundle, KMS ephemeral role, runtime traces, archive mirror, retest hold).
security-bot: Created SEC-4033: "Assessment custody + retest SLA" and added checklist. Assigned priya and james. Reminder set 48h before dry-run.
priya: Action list: baseline snapshot -> upload -> dry-run -> post-window archive mirror -> post-window rotate creds. Will post presigned URLs and ephemeral role ARN here after dry-run.
morgan: Thanks. Keep updates in SEC-4033. If anything blocks, escalate to #incidents and ping @ops-oncall.
